'''Nahdar Vebb's Lightsaber''' was the lightsaber wielded by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] during the galaxy-wide conflict dubbed the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Vebb wielded it when he traveled to [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]] to re-capture [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] along with his former master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]].

After he was killed by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the cyborg general claimed the lightsaber of the fallen Jedi, and in a duel with Master Fisto, he lost the lightsaber when the Nautolan recovered it and took it back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
